parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page. Valid values:

*   **30**
*   **50**
*   **100**

Default value: 30.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb list-external-data-sources --db-instance-id gp-xxxxxxx --page-size 50 --page-number 1 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
